pathParams.name: workOrderId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the work order to update

requestBody.description: Work order update object. At least one attribute must be provided.

attributes.name: AssignedUsers
attributes.description: Array of AssignedUsers IDs to be updated. Pass in all the assigned users you want to keep. When this is empty, it will drop all assigned users. When this is null or not passed in, it will not change the assigned users.

attributes.name: BillableItems
attributes.description: Array of billable line item attributes present on a work order

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief informative message about the billable line item

attributes.name: GlAccountId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the General Ledger account associated with the billable line item

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: The number of services or goods utilized. Quantity must be a positive number.

attributes.name: Rate
attributes.description: The rate (cost) of the goods or services provided. Valid format is "DD.CC", e.g. "23.33"

attributes.name: CanceledOn
attributes.description: The date the work order status changed to canceled

attributes.name: CompletedOn
attributes.description: The date the work order status changed to Completed

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: The top-level description for a grouping of work orders in AppFolio

attributes.name: Estimates
attributes.description: Use estimates to track anticipated costs for Work Orders. DO NOT INCLUDE Estimates unless one or more estimates have changed. Passing any number of estimates will replace all existing estimates for the work order. Passing an empty array [] will remove all existing estimates for the work order.

attributes.name: VendorId
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the vendor who submitted this estimate. If provided, ManagementCompanyAsVendor must be false or omitted.

attributes.name: ManagementCompanyAsVendor
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the management company is acting as the vendor for the estimate. If true, VendorId must be null or omitted.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The total estimated cost in dollars for completing the work order as quoted by the vendor.

attributes.name: Status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the estimate. Only one estimate can have Approved status at a time per work order. Enum: "Pending" "Approved" "Not Approved"

attributes.name: InternalNotes
attributes.description: Internal notes or comments attached to the estimate. These notes are for internal use only and not visible to vendors or owners.

attributes.name: EstimateRequestedDate
attributes.description: The date the estimate was requested from the Vendor.

attributes.name: EstimateReceivedDate
attributes.description: The date the estimate was received from the Vendor. If Amount is provided but EstimateReceivedDate is not specified, it will automatically default to today's date.

attributes.name: InventoryDetails
attributes.description: Array of InventoryDetails objects to be updated. Pass in all the inventory details you want to keep. When this is empty, it will drop all inventory details. When this is null or not passed in, it will not change the inventory details.

attributes.name: InventoryId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the inventory item

attributes.name: GlAccountId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the GL account associated with the inventory detail

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the inventory item used

attributes.name: Rate
attributes.description: The rate of the inventory item

attributes.name: JobDescription
attributes.description: A brief description of the work order to be performed

attributes.name: LaborItems
attributes.description: Array of labor line item attributes present on a work order

attributes.name: Date
attributes.description: The date the labor was completed. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD" e.g. "2020-12-01".

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief informative message about the labor performed

attributes.name: HoursWorked
attributes.description: The number of hours worked by the maintenance tech

attributes.name: HoursBillable
attributes.description: The number of hours worked by the maintenance tech that are billable, used to create the work order bill

attributes.name: UserId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the maintenance tech assigned to the work order

attributes.name: ManagementCompanyAsVendor
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the management company is the vendor for the work order. If false, the assigned vendor company will be dropped.

attributes.name: PermissionToEnter
attributes.description: Occupancy has given permission to enter unit

attributes.name: Priority
attributes.description: The priority of the work order. Enum: "Urgent" "Normal" "Low"

attributes.name: ScheduledEnd
attributes.description: When the work order is scheduled to be completed. If ScheduledEnd is null, it will be considered scheduled for 'all day'. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

attributes.name: ScheduledStart
attributes.description: When the work order is scheduled to start. Set this value together with ScheduledEnd. The time difference between ScheduledStart and ScheduledEnd should not exceed 12 hours unless it is scheduled for 'all day'. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

attributes.name: Status
attributes.description: The status of the work order. Enum: "Assigned" "Canceled" "Completed" "New" "Scheduled" "Waiting" "Work Completed"

attributes.name: VendorId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the vendor associated with the work order. When the value of this attribute is null, it will drop the assigned vendor. When present, ManagementCompanyAsVendor cannot be true.

attributes.name: VendorTrade
attributes.description: The type of service offered by the vendor. Pass "" to remove the vendor trade.

attributes.name: WorkCompletedOn
attributes.description: The date the work order was completed

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated work order
